title: 第一卷 第14章 下马威
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
【每日结算面板开启】

    【今日结算：击杀青帮炼骨境一人，击杀青帮三十二人，重伤青帮二十七人，击伤海河帮九人。】

    【获得：大洋+20，气血值+10，武道经验+10年！】

    【目前每日结算等级LV1，每日奖励额外X1倍】

    武道经验！

    靠在沙发上假寐的陆川猛地睁开双眼。

    这是第一次出现的结算奖励。

    陆川赶忙打开属性面板，发现武技大力鹰爪功和功法养气决后面都出现了一个小小的+号。

    只犹豫了一秒钟，陆川就将十年武道经验加在了大力鹰爪功上。

    对于现在的他来说，只有拳头够硬，才能在这乱世里活下去。

    轰！

    陆川只感觉自己脑子里瞬间炸开。

    无数与大力鹰爪功相关的武道经验疯狂涌现。

    他缓缓起身，身形随着脑中无数有关于大力鹰爪功的招式舞动起来。

    扣！撕！点！抓！拿......

    雄鹰探爪、铁爪锁喉、扑鹰坠爪.....

    鹰啸碎骨爪、千影连环爪、苍鹰吞日爪......

    “呼......”

    半晌后，陆川收功缓缓呼出一口浊气。

    十年武道经验已经被他尽数消化，大力鹰爪功也从一开始的入门，直接跳过了初窥门径、登堂入室、融会贯通，进入了炉火纯青之境。

    陆川不知道别人修炼十年大力鹰爪功是否能在十年内达到炉火纯青，反正他是做到了。

    “变强的感觉，还真是好啊！”

    看着自己更加坚韧的双掌，陆川眼中的激动简直溢于言表。

    这时，外面响起了一阵汽车的声音。

    陆川走到门口看去，只见一辆汽车停在小洋楼前。

    前面的车门打开，一个身穿黑褂子的司机恭敬地将后车门打开。

    就见面露惊慌不安的陆小鱼从车里走了出来。

    她现在整个人都还是懵的。

    青帮的混子莫名其妙地被人解决了。

    窝棚里莫名其妙地进来好几个人，说是带自己去找哥哥。

    然后莫名其妙地去了一趟医馆。

    再然后就莫名其妙地来到了这里。

    当处于懵逼中的陆小鱼看到陆川大步走来的时候，心中所有的不安和恐惧全都莫名消失了。

    “哥！”

    ......

    天刚蒙蒙亮。

    海河帮总舵，后院演武场。

    几十号光膀子的大汉正在练拳，喊杀声震天响。

    这里就是镇涛堂的驻地。

    陆川提着精铁长棍，慢悠悠地晃了进去。

    他穿了一身崭新的青色绸缎长衫，脚踩千层底布鞋，头发梳得一丝不苟。

    看起来不像个混帮派的，倒像个教书先生。

    演武场瞬间安静下来。

    几十双眼睛齐刷刷地盯着陆川。

    有审视，有敌意，更多的是不屑。

    “哟，这谁啊？”

    一个独眼大汉坐在太师椅上，手里盘着两颗铁核桃，咔嚓咔嚓作响。

    他光着膀子，胸口纹着一头下山虎，满脸横肉，左眼上有一道狰狞的刀疤。

    正是镇涛堂堂主，独眼龙，裘然！

    “听说是帮主新收了兄弟，还要来咱们这儿当副堂主？”

    裘然斜着眼，上下打量着陆川，嘴角挂着一丝讥讽。

    “小子，镇涛堂是杀人的地方，不是托儿所。”

    “你会打架吗？”

    陆川没理他。

    他走到演武场中央，把精铁长棍往地上一杵。

    “咚！”

    沉闷的响声让地面都震了三震。

    “我是陆川。”

    “以后，我管你们。”

    声音不大，但很清晰。

    裘然愣了一下，随即哈哈大笑起来。

    “听见没？这小子说要管咱们！”

    周围的混混们也跟着起哄。

    “哪来的小白脸，毛长齐了吗？”

    “副堂主？我看是来送菜的吧！”

    “滚回去喝奶吧！”

    裘然站起身，把铁核桃往桌上一拍。

    “小子，规矩懂不懂？”

    “想当副堂主，得先过了我这关。”
content_en:
[Daily settlement panel opens]

    [Today’s settlement: One person from the Qing Gang’s Bone Refining Realm was killed, thirty-two people from the Qing Gang were killed, 27 people from the Qing Gang were seriously injured, and nine people from the Haihe Gang were injured. 】

    [Obtain: Dayang +20, Vitality +10, Martial Arts Experience +10 Years! 】

    [The current daily settlement level is LV1, and the daily reward is extra X1 times]

    Martial arts experience!

    Lu Chuan, who was sleeping on the sofa, suddenly opened his eyes.

    This is the first time a settlement bonus has appeared.

    Lu Chuan hurriedly opened the attribute panel and found that a small + sign appeared behind the martial arts vigorous Eagle Claw Kung Fu and the Kung Fu Qi Yang Jue.

    After only a second of hesitation, Lu Chuan added ten years of martial arts experience to the powerful eagle claw technique.

    For him now, only if his fist is strong enough can he survive in this troubled world.

    boom!

    Lu Chuan felt as if his mind was exploding.

    Countless martial arts experiences related to the powerful Eagle Claw Technique emerged crazily.

    He stood up slowly, his body dancing with countless moves related to the powerful eagle claw technique in his mind.

    buckle! tear! point! Grasp! take...

    The eagle probes its claws, iron claws lock its throat, the eagle flutters and drops its claws...

    Eagle Screaming Bone-Crushing Claw, Thousand Shadows Chain Claw, Goshawk Sun-Swallowing Claw...

    "Huh..."

    After a while, Lu Chuan finished his work and slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.

    Ten years of martial arts experience have been digested by him, and the powerful Eagle Claw Kung Fu has skipped the first glimpse, entrance, and mastery from the beginning, and entered the realm of perfection.

    Lu Chuan didn't know if others could achieve proficiency in the Eagle Claw Technique within ten years after practicing it for ten years, but he did it anyway.

    "It feels really good to become stronger!"

    Looking at his stronger palms, the excitement in Lu Chuan's eyes was beyond words.

    At this time, there was a sound of cars outside.

    Lu Chuan walked to the door and looked, only to see a car parked in front of the small foreign-style building.

    The front door opened, and a driver in a black coat respectfully opened the rear door.

    Lu Xiaoyu walked out of the car when he saw a panicked Lu Xiaoyu.

    She is still confused now.

    The gangsters from the Qing Gang were inexplicably eliminated.

    Several people came into the shack out of nowhere, saying they were taking him to find his brother.

    Then I went to the medical clinic for no apparent reason.

    Then I came here inexplicably.

    When the confused Lu Xiaoyu saw Lu Chuan striding towards him, all the uneasiness and fear in his heart disappeared inexplicably.

    "Brother!"

    ...

    It's just dawn.

    He is the chief helmsman of the Haihe Gang and has a martial arts field in the backyard.

    Dozens of shirtless men were practicing boxing, and the shouts of killing were loud.

    This is where Zhentao Hall is located.

    Lu Chuan held the fine iron long stick and slowly swayed in.

    He wore a brand-new blue satin gown, mille-layer cloth shoes, and his hair was combed meticulously.

    He doesn't look like a gangster, but like a teacher.

    The martial arts arena instantly became quiet.

    Dozens of pairs of eyes stared at Lu Chuan.

    There is scrutiny, hostility, and even more disdain.

    "Hey, who is this?"

    A one-eyed man was sitting on the Taishi chair, with two iron walnuts in his hand, making a clicking sound.

    He was shirtless, with a tiger descending from the mountain tattooed on his chest, his face was full of flesh, and there was a ferocious scar on his left eye.

    It is none other than the one-eyed dragon, Qiu Ran, the leader of Zhentao Hall!

    "I heard that the gang leader has recruited a new brother, and he wants to come to our place as deputy hall leader?"

    Qiu Ran squinted his eyes and looked Lu Chuan up and down, with a trace of sarcasm hanging on his lips.

    "Boy, Zhentao Hall is a place for killing people, not a nursery."

    "Can you fight?"

    Lu Chuan ignored him.

    He walked to the center of the martial arts arena and struck the long iron stick on the ground.

    "Boom!"

    The dull sound made the ground tremble three times.

    "I'm Lu Chuan."

    "I'll take care of you from now on."

    It's not loud, but it's clear.

    Qiu Ran was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter.

    "Did you hear that? This guy said he wants to take care of us!"

    The surrounding gangsters also followed suit.

    "Where did this pretty boy come from? Has his hair grown evenly?"

    "Deputy Hall Master? I think you're here to deliver food!"

    "Go back and drink milk!"

    Qiu Ran stood up and slapped the iron walnut on the table.

    "Boy, do you understand the rules?"

    "If you want to be the deputy hall master, you must first pass my level."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 14 A show of force
